car.name: Tamarisk 2024
car.description: Original logo-free 2994 SUV based on US 2024 Mazda CX-90 3.3 Turbo Select AWD 8AT, 280 hp regular-fuel version. Combined mild-hybrid envelope; simulation estimates documented.

catalogProvenance.referenceVehicle: US 2024 Mazda CX-90 3.3 Turbo Select AWD 8-speed automatic, 280 hp standard powertrain on regular 87 AKI; not Turbo S or PHEV

sources.access: Mazda North American Operations 2024 specification deck, October 2023. Standard Powertrain and Select columns. Original retained in refs.
2024 OEM owner manual specifications: metric dimensions and 265/55R19 36psi.

gearingStatus.individualRatios: Verified OEM eight-speed automatic ratios, not estimates

estimates: Combined 280hp/332lb-ft powertrain envelope. The 16.6hp/113lb-ft motor is NOT added to these ratings. No independent battery SOC, regeneration or transient electric boost simulation.

Torque curve away from published plateaus, idle750/limiter6800, shift/clutch/launch calibration, AWD35% front split, CG52% front and body subgeometry, grip, drag.35, differentials, suspension, alignment, brakes, efficiency88% and0-60 7s are simulation estimates. Nominal tire radius calculated, not loaded.
Manual Select uses the same eight-speed automatic ratios under player control; it is not a factory manual gearbox. Production clutch/shift model is an approximation.
Original fictional2994 copper-bronze repaired SUV with blank instrument recess and live speed/RPM/gear/fuel retrofit; no badges. Shared tire and wheel graphics.
